reserves.issuerOrObligor: I-ON Digital Corp and GGBR Ltd

sources.label: Goldfish collateral model and designated collateral wallet
ION.au balance in the designated Goldfish collateral wallet

reserveReview.rationale: Goldfish identifies ION.au as GGBR's direct reserve instrument and designates Ethereum wallet 0x2F371Ba19F89874689a91bA322194F9967Cb640D as the collateral wallet. At Ethereum block 25579996 on 2026-07-21, that wallet held 25,000 ION.au while GGBR total supply was 25,000,000, exactly one ION.au per 1,000 GGBR and consistent with the disclosed direct-backing ratio.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Official Goldfish collateral model reconciled to exact Ethereum balances at block 25579996
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The direct reserve instrument and its on-chain quantity are resolved. ION.au's underlying in-situ gold claims, legal enforceability, and off-chain custody remain upstream instrument-quality risks rather than an unidentified GGBR reserve slice.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: ION.au is an untracked tokenized security; its exact current balance in Goldfish's designated collateral wallet is independently readable on Ethereum.

providers.name: ION Treasury and Fireblocks MPC custody

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Goldfish names ION Treasury and Fireblocks MPC custody for the underlying gold-backed securities but does not disclose segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, rehypothecation, or current custody shares.
